scope: Broaden current open-source DWG/DXF peer research around the ACAD_TABLE insertion prefix, reconcile peer issue signals against ODA v5.4.1 and local TABLE code/tests, and add only implementation-ready refinements to existing plan owners.

method.kind: Primary-source web research, local source/test audit, and plan reconciliation
localFilesInspected: src/drw_entities.cpp: DRW_Table::parseDwg reads inherited placement fields before versioned content
src/drw_entities.cpp: DRW_Insert::parseCode converts DXF rotation degrees to model radians
tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp: makeR2007TableFrame and makeR2010EmbeddedTableFrame currently encode default placement values
method.evidenceRule: ODA v5.4.1 is authoritative for DWG layout. Peer issue titles are discovery signals only; inaccessible bodies do not establish reproducers, root cause, status, thresholds, or format semantics. Local generated self-tests establish only the fields and route they actually assert.

observed: ACAD_TABLE inherits INSERT and carries insertion point, version-specific scale, rotation in radians, extrusion, and an ATTRIB-presence bit before table payload.
R2000+ scale uses four valid two-bit encodings: default XYZ, default X with Y/Z deltas, uniform raw scale, and raw X with Y/Z deltas.
AC1021 uses the older table-cell route; AC1024+ changes to inline TABLECONTENT and includes additional prefix fields whose meanings are not fully specified.
doesNotEstablish: The meaning of undocumented AC1024+ prefix fields
A complete table-cell or owner/linkage writer contract
evidence.planUse: Keep AC1021 and AC1024+ routes separate; test documented inherited fields and cursor alignment without interpreting unknown prefix fields.

observed: The current open issue index title reports that R2010+ TABLE data begins with AcDbBlockReference fields: insertion point, scale, rotation, extrusion.
The individual issue body was not retrievable in this pass; no sample, trace, fix status, or exact layout detail was verified.
doesNotEstablish: A DWG rule beyond ODA v5.4.1
A peer implementation result for current LibreDWG master
evidence.planUse: Use as a coverage prompt only; ODA provides the controlling wire contract.

localObservation: DRW_Table inherits DRW_Insert and its parseDwg path reads insertion point, all four scale modes, radians, and extrusion before TABLE content.
The AC1021 generated TABLE frame and AC1024 inline TABLE frame currently encode insertion (4,5,0), unit scale mode 3, zero rotation, and default extrusion.
Existing assertions cover cell semantics and stream boundaries but do not assert inherited placement fields or exercise the other three scale modes.
evidence.classification: Regression-coverage gap; no source-confirmed incorrect decode found in this audit.
evidence.planUse: Extend existing object-vector tests with a 4-mode × 2-version in-memory matrix; assert decoded placement, owner/style handles, content boundary, and a following sentinel.

observed: LibreDWG 0.14.1 NEWS records version-specific TABLESTYLE and SAT-block export work; such release notes are route evidence, not a feature-complete TABLE claim.
LibreDWG #1450–#1452 index titles signal LTYPE dash-text memory safety, FIELD empty-child lifetime, and R2007+ EED/XDATA alignment; their individual bodies were unavailable.
ACadSharp v3.8.0 release notes do not report a new TABLE/ACIS writer capability.
GDAL's DXF reader can inline or merge block geometry subject to options/limits and exposes AC1027+ ASM bytes/transforms without constructing OGR solids.
evidence.planUse: Map signals to existing 7BF, FIELD/7G.3d, PAR-19, PAR-126 and composed comparator gates. Keep peers out of fast tests and do not copy peer thresholds or claim semantics.

existingOwnersRefined: 7G.3d versioned ACAD_TABLE parser vectors and bounded 2D INSERT compatibility
PAR-126 ACAD_TABLE/TABLECONTENT completeness and route separation
FIELD/7G.3d FIELD graph and empty-child handling

nextActions: When 7G.3d resumes, extend the existing AC1021 and AC1024 TABLE vector builders with all four R2000+ scale modes, non-default insertion/rotation/extrusion, explicit field assertions, and suffix alignment; do not add a new CTest or fixture.
Retain the current next local implementation queue; this research does not reorder work around 7BF.3.
If a local LTYPE, FIELD, or EED/XDATA owner is next changed, use primary-source field scopes and a small generated local regression; do not infer a spec rule from LibreDWG issue titles.
